description: JWKS / JWK security checker — Audit a JSON Web Key Set used to verify JWTs. url= a JWKS URL or an OIDC issuer (follows /.well-known/openid-configuration to jwks_uri), or text= JWKS/JWK JSON. Per key: kty, alg, use, kid, RSA bits/exponent, EC/OKP curve and coordinate checks, WebCrypto importability, RFC 7638 thumbprint, x5c certificate expiry + key match + x5t/x5t#S256 checks. Flags published private keys or HMAC secrets (CRITICAL, values never echoed), alg none, HS* on public keys, alg/kty/curve mismatches, small RSA keys, duplicate or missing kids, RSA1_5, private key_ops, plain HTTP, missing Cache-Control, single key with no rotation standby. Verdict PASS / REVIEW / FAIL / CRITICAL. Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_jwks_check
